integrity: The exact-arithmetic checker and digit-pattern induction support the universal statement; finite enumerations are supplementary checks, not a proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns nested powers b and b^k with integer k at least two. It proves a two-sided counting order, not a universal asymptotic leading constant. A complete search of unindexed literature and independent proof audit has not been performed.
title: Exact digit classification and counting of palindromes in every dependent base pair
